## One skill at a time.

Short instructions. Lighter, cheaper chats.

Agent instructions

Every job pasted in → one line: "check the skill index".

--- name: release-note description: Use when writing a short release note or changelog for a ship. --- Write a short note: what shipped, what the user does next. Stop. Do not review slides or diffs.

### Anatomy of a skill

- name and description : all your agent sees until the job comes up.

- The body loads only for that job.

- No match? It searches skill marketplaces and adds one only when you say add.

## What it can and can't touch.

### It can

- Review the agents you put in scope

- Write tests and suggest small fixes

- Add a skill to your local library, after your yes

### It never

- Changes an agent's purpose

- Deletes or renames an agent without your yes

- Applies a change you haven't seen

- Sends, posts, spends or deletes for you

### On the network

- Only when no local skill fits

- Searches public marketplace APIs and reads listings only

- Nothing is saved until you say add

- No tracking in the plugin

Code and text are MIT. Names, logos and the raven are not ( brand license ). Found a security issue? Report it privately .
